approaches.name: Regulated indirect SPEI participation scheme for payment institutions
approaches.description: Prior action sets rules letting financial entities join SPEI indirectly, cutting cost of digital payments
approaches.why_innovative: New process: indirect participation rules widen payment access - cue: 'digital payment' | category Financial; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: The PA supports regulatory reforms to enhance the availability of digital payment services through clear rules for the indirect participation of financial institutions in SPEI while also enhancing the consumer experience for SPEI and CoDi services and ensuring a robust and modern payments system.

extra_evidence.text: The regulations establish rules for indirect participation in SPEI and set out the specific parameters under which direct participants will offer indirect participation services.

The new regulated indirect participation scheme is expected to have a positive impact on financial inclusion by enabling greater and more affordable46 access to SPEI for financial institutions and thus improving accessibility and affordability of SPEI-enabled digital payment services (for example, international remittances and CoDi payments) for their customers.

category.rationale: Financial: changes payment market access and affordability

sector.rationale: SPEI payment system participation rules for financial entities directly serve banking/payment institutions.

adoption.rationale: Digital core: SPEI indirect participation rules | Innovative: opens interbank rails to indirect participants | Category: financial access

approaches.innovation_basis: New process: indirect participation rules widen payment access - cue: 'digital payment'
